from.name: Internet Message Format lineage
from.revision: RFC 822-descended message model represented by RFC 5322

property: MIME preserves the surrounding Internet message/header model while adding typed, multipart, encoded and non-ASCII-capable body/content representation.

date_or_range.notes: MIME generations extend the RFC 822 message world; RFC 2045 is a later consolidated MIME generation.

sources.supports: MIME explicitly extends the RFC 822 message representation rather than replacing the entire mail architecture

negative_claims: MIME is not a replacement SMTP transport protocol.
MIME does not define DNS mail routing or mailbox-access semantics.
open_questions: Build MIME revision genealogy and media-type registry history.
Trace reuse of MIME conventions outside email separately.
